_notes.place: Required. The place the map centers on, as it shows at the top of the screen, up to 80 characters.
_notes.lat: Required. The place's latitude in degrees, from -85 to 85. Your agent looks it up from the town you name.
_notes.lon: Required. The place's longitude in degrees, from -180 to 180.
_notes.zoom: Optional. "town" shows about 250 km around the place, "region" about 1,000 km. Default: "town".
_notes.layers: Optional. The layers on at the start, from "radar", "wind", and "clouds"; each one switches on and off in Settings. Default: ["radar", "wind"].
_notes.units: Optional. "metric" for mm/h and km/h, "imperial" for in/h and mph. Default: "metric".
_notes.theme: Optional. "auto" follows the device: the night map in dark mode and the paper map in light mode. "dark" is always the night map, "paper" always the paper map. Default: "auto".
_notes.sample: Optional. true plays the sample loop (rain moving in from the west and reaching the place in 24 minutes) over a map drawn for the place, and never asks the live feeds; false shows the live radar, wind, and map. Default: false.
